nuke.damage_math: Charged Shot, maxed: (80 base + 54 Tier-2 upgrade = 134) + ×1.0 scaling × 208 SP (final loadout Spirit Power from items: 181 flat + 15% (Boundless Spirit) ≈ 208 effective) = ~342 damage per shot on the API/wiki published scaling. Tier 3 improves the scaling further — an older patch note pegged the T3 bonus at +1.3 (×2.3 total), which would make it ~612. Surge of Power's Spirit Power is already inside the 208. Verdict on the '~1,000 damage per shot' claim: not from the item build alone. Four figures needs a fed game stacked on top — Guided Owl's +8 permanent Spirit Power per kill, level boons, and Mystic Reverb's echo on the same shot. The honest build-only number is ~342–612.
nuke.kit_synergy: Every imbue goes on Charged Shot. Expansion and Surge of Power feed the shot, cooldown compression keeps a charged arrow ready for every peek, and Echo Shard + Mystic Reverb mean the shot they dodge is followed by the one they don't.
